jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the edit target. Image2 is supporting PHYSICAL marker swatches: use ONLY its handwritten hand-painted swatches as hue/value evidence; ignore printed instructions and all photographic background. Correct every colored fill to its specified marker code, not just labels. Preserve subject, composition, poses, geometry, step sequence, black contours and marker stroke texture. Flat single-marker blocks, no invented gradients or opaque paint. White objects stay reserved paper. Existing incorrect English color names and misleading color adjectives must be replaced by the actual Chinese descriptions below. Number codes stay unchanged except clock25 becomes9. Do not keep neon hues when actual swatch is muted/pale. All colors permitted:

68 = 中等青蓝（照片观察）
35 = 偏黄绿的黄色（照片观察）
23 = 橙色（照片观察）
